title: Predicting the risk of malignancy in adnexal masses based on the Simple Rules from the International Ovarian Tumor Analysis (IOTA) group
evidence_level: Tier-1 Validated Clinical Prediction System (N=4,848 adnexal masses)

benign_features_b_rules.B1: Unilocular cyst (no septa, no solid components).
benign_features_b_rules.B2: Presence of solid components with largest diameter < 7 mm.
benign_features_b_rules.B4: Smooth multilocular tumor with largest diameter < 100 mm.
benign_features_b_rules.B5: No blood flow detected on Color Doppler (Color Score 1).

malignant_features_m_rules.M4: Irregular multilocular-solid tumor with largest diameter ≥ 100 mm.
malignant_features_m_rules.M5: Very strong blood flow on Color Doppler (Color Score 4).

classic_decision_logic.Benign: Only B-features present and no M-features present.
classic_decision_logic.Malignant: Only M-features present and no B-features present.
classic_decision_logic.Inconclusive / Inapplicable: Both B-features and M-features present OR neither B-features nor M-features present (occurs in ~20-25% of masses -> requires Simple Rules Risk Model or Expert Triage).

simple_rules_risk_model_formula: Calculates estimated risk percentage (%) continuously for all masses regardless of rule concordance (Sensitivity 95.4%, Specificity 88.6% at 10% risk cutoff).
